questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "LETHARGIC"
questions.explanation: LETHARGIC का अर्थ होता है सुस्त, आलसी या शिथिल। Synonym: Sluggish, Lazy, Indolent, Inactive.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "LETHARGIC"
questions.explanation: LETHARGIC (सुस्त) का Antonym है Energetic (ऊर्जावान) या Active (सक्रिय).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "COMPASSIONATE"
questions.explanation: COMPASSIONATE का अर्थ होता है दयालु, सहानुभूतिपूर्ण या कृपालु। Synonym: Sympathetic, Merciful, Kind.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "COMPASSIONATE"
questions.explanation: COMPASSIONATE (दयालु) का Antonym है Cruel (क्रूर) या Callous (निर्दयी).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "INADVERTENT"
questions.explanation: INADVERTENT का अर्थ होता है अनजाने में हुआ, असावधान या आकस्मिक। Synonym: Unintentional, Accidental.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "INADVERTENT"
questions.explanation: INADVERTENT (अनजाने में) का Antonym है Deliberate (जानबूझकर किया हुआ) या Intentional.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "OBNOXIOUS"
questions.explanation: OBNOXIOUS का अर्थ होता है अप्रिय, घिनौना या अप्रीतिकर। Synonym: Offensive, Disgusting, Repulsive.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "OBNOXIOUS"
questions.explanation: OBNOXIOUS (अप्रिय/घिनौना) का Antonym है Pleasant (सुहावना) या Delightful.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "Words inscribed on a tombstone in memory of the person buried there"
questions.explanation: समाधि पर खुदे हुए लेख या शब्दों को Epitaph (समाधि लेख) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who leaves his own country to settle permanently in another"
questions.explanation: अपना देश छोड़कर दूसरे देश बसने जाने वाले को Emigrant (उत्प्रवासी) कहते हैं (I = In, Immigrant = आगत निवासी)।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who comes to a foreign country to settle permanently there"
questions.explanation: विदेश से आकर बसने वाले व्यक्ति को Immigrant (अप्रवासी) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A state of lawlessness and disorder due to absence of government or control"
questions.explanation: सरकार या कानून व्यवस्था की अनुपस्थिति में उत्पन्न अराजकता को Anarchy (अराजकता) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "An extreme, morbid or irrational fear of water"
questions.explanation: पानी से अत्यधिक भय/डर को Hydrophobia कहते हैं (रेबीज रोग का प्रमुख लक्षण)।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "A piece of cake"
options: A very easy task or accomplishment
questions.explanation: A piece of cake = बच्चों का खेल, बहुत ही आसान काम।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Add fuel to the fire"
options: To make a bad situation or argument worse
questions.explanation: Add fuel to the fire = आग में घी डालना, मामले को और बिगाड़ना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "At the drop of a hat"
options: When a hat falls on the ground
Instantly / without any delay or hesitation
questions.explanation: At the drop of a hat = बिना किसी हिचकिचाहट के, तुरंत।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Back to square one"
options: To win a game of chess
Back to the beginning / start all over again
questions.explanation: Back to square one = पुनः शुरुआती बिंदु पर आ जाना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Barking up the wrong tree"
options: To bark at a dog under a tree
To cut down the wrong tree
Accusing or pursuing the wrong person or direction
questions.explanation: Barking up the wrong tree = गलत व्यक्ति या दिशा में प्रयास करना।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "He is superior than me in intelligence."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Superior' के साथ preposition 'to' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं (superior to me).

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "Either the manager or the workers has made a mistake."
questions.explanation: Rule: Either...or में निकटतम सब्जेक्ट ('workers' प्लुरल) के अनुसार प्लुरल वर्ब 'have' आएगा।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "I have not seen him since two months."
questions.explanation: Rule: अनिश्चित अवधि ('two months') के साथ प्रपोजिशन 'for' आता है (for two months).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He was prevented _____ doing his work."
questions.explanation: Rule: Prevent, Refrain, Abstain, Debar आदि verbs के साथ प्रपोजिशन 'from' + V-ing आता है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "She is good _____ Mathematics."
questions.explanation: Rule: किसी विषय या कार्य में निपुण/अच्छा होने पर 'Good at' आता है ('Good in' गलत है).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "I am fond _____ reading story books."
questions.explanation: Rule: Adjective 'Fond' के साथ हमेशा preposition 'of' आता है (Fond of reading).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "RETICENT"
questions.explanation: RETICENT का अर्थ होता है कम बोलने वाला, संकोची या मौन। Synonym: Reserved, Taciturn, Silent.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "RETICENT"
questions.explanation: RETICENT (कम बोलने वाला) का Antonym है Garrulous (बातूनी) या Talkative.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "ZEALOUS"
questions.explanation: ZEALOUS का अर्थ होता है उत्साही या जोशिला। Synonym: Enthusiastic, Ardent, Passionate.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "ZEALOUS"
questions.explanation: ZEALOUS (उत्साही) का Antonym है Apathetic (उदासीन) या Indifferent.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who loves, collects or is intensely interested in books"
questions.explanation: पुस्तक प्रेमी को Bibliophile कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who collects or studies coins, medals and currency"
questions.explanation: सिक्कों के संग्रहकर्ता/अध्ययनकर्ता को Numismatist (मुद्राशास्त्री) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who collects or studies postage stamps"
questions.explanation: डाक टिकटों के संग्रहकर्ता को Philatelist (डाक टिकट संग्रही) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "One who is all powerful and has unlimited power"
questions.explanation: सर्वशक्तिमान को Omnipotent कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "One who is present everywhere at the same time"
questions.explanation: सर्वव्यापी (जो हर जगह मौजूद हो) को Omnipresent कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "One who knows everything and has complete knowledge"
questions.explanation: सर्वज्ञ (सब कुछ जानने वाला) को Omniscient कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Cost an arm and a leg"
questions.explanation: Cost an arm and a leg = अत्यधिक महँगा होना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Don't judge a book by its cover"
options: Always check the cover of a book
Never buy a book with a bad cover
Don't form an opinion based purely on external appearance
Read the whole book before reviewing
questions.explanation: Don't judge a book by its cover = केवल बाहरी रूप-रंग देखकर राय न बनाना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Give someone the cold shoulder"
options: To intentionally ignore or treat someone coldly
questions.explanation: Give someone the cold shoulder = किसी की उपेक्षा करना या बेरुखी से व्यवहार करना।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "He refrained <u>to answer</u> the question."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Refrain' के साथ preposition 'from' + Gerund (V-ing) आता है (refrained from answering).

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "<u>Unless you do not work hard</u>, you will fail."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Unless' स्वयं नकारात्मक (Negative) शब्द है, अतः इसके साथ 'not' का प्रयोग नहीं होता।

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "She has finished the work."
options: The work was finished by her.
The work is finished by her.
The work has been finished by her.
The work had been finished by her.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect (has + V3) का Passive = Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "Close the door."
options: You are requested to close door.
questions.explanation: Imperative sentence (Command/Order) का Passive = Let + Object + be + V3.

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: He said to me, "Where are you going?"
options: He asked me where was I going.
He asked me where I was going.
He told me where I am going.
He asked me where I am going.
questions.explanation: Interrogative WH- sentence का Indirect = asked + me + where + I (Subject) + was going.

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: She said, "Alas! I have failed."
options: She said with grief that I have failed.
She exclaimed with sorrow that she had failed.
She exclaimed with joy that she failed.
questions.explanation: Exclamatory sentence ('Alas!') का Indirect = exclaimed with sorrow + that + she had failed.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "GULLIBLE"
questions.explanation: GULLIBLE का अर्थ होता है सीधा-साधा, जिसे आसानी से बेवकूफ बनाया जा सके। Synonym: Credulous, Naive.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "GULLIBLE"
questions.explanation: GULLIBLE (भोला-भाला) का Antonym है Cynical (शक्की) या Suspicious.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A medicine or substance given to counteract the effects of a poison"
questions.explanation: विष के प्रभाव को काटने वाली औषधि को Antidote (विषघ्न/काट) कहते हैं।

questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी GUARANTEE (गारंटी/आश्वासन) है।
